title: Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
script:
Google is bringing its Gemini AI to your car dashboard.
This update lets Gemini access your personal information across six different apps.
It pulls data from Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, YouTube, and Search.
You can ask Gemini about your flight status while driving.
The AI uses your data to provide context-aware answers.
This feature is rolling out to cars with Google built-in.
The system also supports Android Auto for your existing vehicle.
Would you let AI manage your schedule while driving?

editor.one_line: Strong, clear reporting, but the visuals are repetitive and lack dynamic variety.
script_fixes: LINE 5: Remove this line; it is vague filler that adds no new information.
LINE 8: Change to 'Would you trust Gemini to manage your schedule while driving?' for more impact.
visual_notes: line 2: The same static text layout is held for too long across multiple frames.
line 3: Visuals are just a series of app icons; needs more dynamic B-roll of the car interface.
line 5: The visual is just a text box; lacks a supporting graphic or animation.
line 7: The Android Auto logo is held for too long without a visual transition.
